contract.task_clause:
A silyl radical bearing an Si-H· fragment has a g value of 2.0033 and a pair of lines separated by 15.5 MHz. Express the splitting in units of mT, Gauss and cm-1.
Option A: 15.5 MHz = 11.104 mT = 27.201 Gauss = 0.862 x 10^-4 cm-1
Option B: 15.5 MHz = 7.352 mT = 10.104 Gauss = 18.39 x 10^-4 cm-1
Option C: 15.5 MHz = 1.55 mT = 0.562 Gauss = 31.0 x 10^-4 cm-1
Option D: 15.5 MHz = 0.553 mT = 5.530 Gauss = 5.17 x 10^-4 cm-1
